name: Thunder
look: Thunder shield from cultivation fantasy. A sphere of crackling purple-white lightning surrounds the character, jagged arcs crawling over its surface.
subject: shield

rows.name: INIT
rows.caption: shield forms
rows.text: sparks gather round the character and snap together into the crackling sphere

rows.name: IDLE
rows.caption: shield holds
rows.text: arcs crawl and flicker over the sphere's surface in different places each frame; it loops

rows.name: HIT
rows.caption: blow lands from the right
rows.text: a blow comes from the right; a thick bolt of lightning arcs out from the sphere to the right and strikes back at it, a white flash at the contact

rows.name: BREAK
rows.caption: shield ends
rows.text: the sphere collapses inward into a last bright flash and a few fading sparks
